# PStack upstream snapshot

Verbatim selected skills from Lauren Tan’s MIT-licensed `cursor/plugins` PStack.
`UPSTREAM.json` pins the source commit and every included file hash.

This is source storage, not a plugin or an additional skill discovery root.
Only the ten already-selected upstream skills are mirrored; agents, automations,
other skills and Cursor plugin metadata are excluded.

Do not edit this snapshot. Run `python3 scripts/sync-pstack-skills --update`
from the repository root; review the upstream diff and packaged output together.
Local sources live in `pstack/custom/`; see `pstack/README.md`.
